tests.description: Check the solution with the tests
cases: wordCount keeps an apostrophe inside a word
wordCount of empty text is empty
wordCount of only punctuation is empty
wordCount handles extra spaces and line breaks
topWords puts the most frequent first
topWords with n larger than the number of words
topWords with n of zero is empty

assistant.context: A single file exercise. wordcount.js has two stub functions, wordCount(text) and topWords(text, n), and a few example calls at the bottom. It runs with `node wordcount.js` and exports both functions with module.exports. The tests are in wordcount.test.js (Node's built in test runner, `node --test wordcount.test.js`, the Run tests button does the same); they fail until the functions are implemented. There are no dependencies. description.md is the brief the candidate reads first.
